newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Alpargatas proposes bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Alpargatas proposes bond issue.

text.p: Argentina's textiles manufacturer Alpargatas SAIC said Monday it has proposed to soon issue a bond of between $150 million and $200 million.

In a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange, Alpargatas said company directors had proposed the issuance of a medium- or long-term bond to replace short-term liabilities. The bond will be placed in the Eurobond and/or U.S. market.
The bond would come under a $250 million negotiable bond program which was also proposed at the firm's recent board meeting.
